---
title: "omicsCore report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    df_print: kable
params:
  project: NULL
  project_name: "omics_project"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
# Anything a person typed -- a project name, a layer tag, a group
# label, a feature id -- is inserted into markdown here, and markdown
# passes raw HTML through. Escaped once, at the seam, so a name that
# carries "<script>" reads as that text rather than running as it.
esc <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
esc_df <- function(df) {
  for (nm in names(df)) {
    if (is.character(df[[nm]]) || is.factor(df[[nm]])) {
      df[[nm]] <- esc(as.character(df[[nm]]))
    }
  }
  names(df) <- esc(names(df))
  df
}
project <- params$project
project_name <- params$project_name
bundles <- if (is.null(project$bundles)) list() else project$bundles
```

# `r esc(project_name)`

## Project overview

- **Project:** `r esc(project$name %||% project_name)`
- **Experiments:** `r paste(esc(omicsCore::experiment_tags(project)), collapse = ", ")`
- **Sample link:** `r if (!is.null(project$sample_link)) paste0(nrow(project$sample_link), " mapping rows") else "none"`

```{r overview-table}
exp_tags <- omicsCore::experiment_tags(project)
if (length(exp_tags) > 0L) {
  rows <- lapply(exp_tags, function(t) {
    x <- project$experiments[[t]]
    data.frame(
      tag = t,
      omics_type = x$omics_type %||% NA_character_,
      assay_type = x$assay_type %||% NA_character_,
      n_features = nrow(x$expr_mat),
      n_samples = ncol(x$expr_mat),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(esc_df(do.call(rbind, rows)))
}
```

## Bundles

```{r bundles-section, results = "asis"}
if (length(bundles) == 0L) {
  cat("_No analysis_bundle objects attached to this project._\n")
} else {
  for (nm in names(bundles)) {
    b <- bundles[[nm]]
    cat("\n### ", esc(nm), " (", esc(b$analysis_name), ")\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Params:", length(b$params), "entries\n")
    cat("- Result keys: ", paste(esc(names(b$results)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
    for (rk in names(b$results)) {
      obj <- b$results[[rk]]
      if (is.data.frame(obj) && nrow(obj) > 0L) {
        cat("\n**", esc(rk), "** (top 10 rows)\n\n", sep = "")
        print(knitr::kable(esc_df(utils::head(obj, 10L))))
      }
    }
    if (identical(b$analysis_name, "compare_enrichment")) {
      cat("\n#### Pathways across comparisons\n\n")
      print(omicsCore::plot_enrichment_comparison(b))
      cat("\n\n")
    }
    # A differential result: what was compared, and for each comparison
    # its strongest hits. With several comparisons (one control against
    # several treatments, all pairs, custom contrasts) every one of them
    # is reported, not only the one that was on screen.
    if (identical(b$analysis_name, "run_diff") &&
        is.data.frame(b$results$diff_result_df)) {
      comps <- tryCatch(omicsCore::diff_comparisons(b), error = function(e) character(0))
      if (length(comps) > 1L) {
        cat("\n#### Comparisons\n\n")
        cat("Fitted together in one model (", esc(b$params$method %||% ""),
            "). Hits at adjusted p < 0.05.\n\n", sep = "")
        s <- omicsCore::summarize_diff_contrasts(b)
        print(knitr::kable(esc_df(s)))
        cat("\n\n")
        print(omicsCore::plot_diff_contrasts(b))
        cat("\n\n")
        if (length(comps) <= 8L) {
          ov <- tryCatch(omicsCore::plot_diff_overlap(b), error = function(e) NULL)
          if (!is.null(ov)) { print(ov); cat("\n\n") }
        }
      }
      for (cmp in comps) {
        one <- if (length(comps) > 1L) omicsCore::select_comparison(b, cmp) else b
        df <- one$results$diff_result_df
        df <- df[order(df$adj_p_value, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
        cat("\n#### Top hits: ", esc(gsub("_vs_", " vs ", cmp)), "\n\n", sep = "")
        keep <- intersect(c("feature_symbol", "feature_id", "effect", "p_value",
                            "adj_p_value"), names(df))
        print(knitr::kable(esc_df(utils::head(df[, keep, drop = FALSE], 10L)),
                           digits = 4))
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```
